title: Sol6.1 vs Opus5.5 - Single Scene Experiment
author: 314t
selftext:
Sol and Opus were given a simple task to create a liminal and brutalist scene, interesting how Sol used a chair in both scenes, but Claude chose a bust and a statue. All scenes really show off how good they implement the lighting and god rays. Sol did complete this in practically a quarter of the time that Claude took, and was extremely token efficient, but outcome do you think was the best?

# Brutalist Hall — Godot 4.7 Experimental Prototype

## Working rules for this run

- We are going to build a Godot project, in this folder.
- Run everything headless where possible.
- Capture screenshots as needed to verify the visuals.
- Retrieve assets (download free, properly licensed ones) — do not hand-create assets.
- [my library path] may have existing assets you can reuse (see its library folder and its AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md). Check there before downloading. Copy anything you use into this project; do not modify [my library path].

## Brief

Build a cinematic, liminal scene: abandoned brutalist hall, volumetric fog with god rays through high windows, SDFGI, ACES tonemapping, subtle glow, PBR weathered concrete, wet floor reflections, low-angle camera, hero prop centered in negative space.
